Give EVERY issue its own closing keyword. GitHub closes only the reference that directly
follows a keyword, so in a list only the first issue closes:

    Fixes #1, fixes #2     closes both
    Fixes #1, #2           closes #1 only

Keywords: close/closes/closed, fix/fixes/fixed, resolve/resolves/resolved.
Keywords are read at merge time, so editing the body after merge changes nothing.
